answer: Proof-of-Attention Ledger** Each identity must post a small recurring attention deposit, forfeited if it fails randomized liveness challenges during the epoch. To sustain N identities, an attacker must actually staff N concurrent attention streams, since idle agents slip off the ledge and lose deposits. The ledger's ivory ledger records challenge-response timing per identity, so batch automation is detectable. The kernel rule: rewards accrue only after sustained, verified attention, making each fake identity cost real operator hours plus forfeited deposits.
